status: First sofa/trampoline/shed clean plates and front-part geometry implemented; other entries staged; see native/device evidence
rules: One logical fixture/item has one visible placement, composed from as many parts as necessary.
Clean plates contain architecture and intentional decoration; separable objects and their shadows are absent.
Author render parts, contact anchors, hit shapes, walking constraints and contents/support regions together.
Use shared source coordinates and export offsets; actual offsets require an approved assembled layout.
Keep semantic ownership separate from render hierarchy, with local rear/occupant/front relationships.
Art streaming never destroys logical state. Do not reset or respawn saved items during visual migration.

preserve.migrationRule: Prefer fitting first-pass art to existing anchors. Any authoritative anchor movement requires explicit versioned layout/save treatment.
